arguments.text: 8000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer sets effort; I watch for weed (speed per pod watt drops, push_local well below push_along -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate disagree -> set pod_gain), course/radio changes (set_race_distance, tell), and check critical power against heart rate after the start settles (min 3-10). Compare legs in same direction to spot drag/drift. Use few cues; keep 3+ in reserve for the end.
